data.summary: As a [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) begins, Orikan may use this ability once per battle. For the rest of that phase, triple his Strength and treat every successful [Wound result](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) he rolls as a Critical Wound.
